summaries.reviewer: Codex, reference-aware seed author; not independent
Codex, reference-aware seed author; not independent

limits: PSS/RSS are simultaneous sampled sums, not sums of process high-water marks.
Sampling is non-atomic; transient/missed processes and short peaks can be absent.
RSS counts shared mappings repeatedly; PSS apportions mapped shared pages.
Orphaned processes can leave the observed ancestry; a verified cgroup accounts for inherited membership.
Process PSS excludes unmapped filesystem cache/kernel charges; cgroup values include controller-accounted memory.
The observer and driver contribute to samples; no editor workload or physical laptop is emulated.

latencyDefinition: Upper median and nearest-rank p95; first non-reasoning JSON output includes the preamble. Complete latency is inference HTTP delivery, with retrieval recorded separately.
scoringLimits: Seed-author agent review, not independent human evaluation.
Strict task score includes response status/source protocol; supported-fact counts are reported separately.
Oracle-source diagnostics are not a proven upper bound; missing linkage and seed ambiguity remain possible.
Both candidates use deterministic greedy decoding; this is not the authors recommended stochastic sampling or a best-capability claim.
Memory is sampled process-tree PSS/RSS with cap_verified=false; physical 16 GB laptop and kernel/PyTorch scale remain unqualified.
